reviews.text: Thanks for taking care of my boy, he is currently chilling out😂. Lovey friendly staff and very professional. I can't recommend you all enough 😁
Couldn't have been better.
Been a client for over 20 years. They’ve taken care of 4 different dogs 3 of them from 8 weeks old I wouldn’t want to go anywhere else.

Fantastic friendly staff, always service with a smile. Vets and staff always take their time with my 2 dogs.

Highly recommended

First class service and as always Roxie was treated great and she was not stressed at all. Roxie is always calm when she is going to the Scotvet and the staff are great and very helpful.
10/01/25
First class service as always, Roxie got 14 teeth out and has recovered well. Thanks so much to all the staff for taking good care of my furbaby.
28/10/2025
Roxie back into see the lovely vets today as has a urine infection. Antibiotics and anti inflammatory,s. Great service as usual
05/10/2026
First class service as always, Roxie treated quickly and efficiently, cannot fault the service or staff. Wouldn,t take roxie anywhere else
09/10/2026
Roxie was back for a wee check up on her eye and she saw anneka who has helped solve Roxie,s issues and is a first class vet. Roxie has always been treated very well at Scotvet and would not take her anywhere else.
Great experience with my puppy, fab service
Very friendly and supportive. Clear detailed information of treatment, medication, progress and prognosis. Very appreciate of all you are doing for my dog.

An absolute 10/10 clinic with staff who have the patience of saints! 🐾
​My little duo, Frankie and Grace, recently went in for their spay surgeries, and I couldn't have asked for a better experience. As a first-time cat owner, my head was spinning with a million questions, but both the vets and the nurses took the time to explain every single detail before and after the procedure. They answered all my endless questions with total kindness and a smile.
​Also, having a Pet Plan with them has honestly been a lifesaver. With two curious, mischievous little Devon Rexes who treat the house like their personal stunt-show and manage to get into trouble on a regular basis, it gives me incredible peace of mind.
​Thank you so much to the whole team for taking such wonderful care of my girls!"

I was very impressed with the staff at Scotvet they were very good with me and zola helping settle any nerves i had with leaving zola in very capable hands.  The staff were very professional and answered any questions I had concerning zola with a lovely smile and kind words if I could have given more stars i would have given scotvet 10 star ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟.....thank you all very much to all staff at scotvet
😊 😊

I honestly can't thank Scotvet Bailieston  and Sandyhills  team enough for everything that they have done and still doing  for our furbaby Honey.
She is a 5 year old French bulldog who has had so many health problems for most of her life, from pancreatitis, skin trouble, constant vomiting and low grade skin cancer. The staff have been through this dogs journey with us.
All the staff have been amazing with help, support and they offer the best advice and treatment plan.
Big thanks to the veterinary surgeons, assistants and reception staff who are just the best team.  The team are still helping my dog with an ongoing health condition at the moment.
We really do appreciate everything that you do for Honey.
Thank you to all the hardworking staff, we can’t praise you all enough. 😊 We now have another Rescue Frenchie called Chase who also has a number of health issues, such as kidneys, lump in his neck, problems with back legs.
The team are trying their very best   to investigate Chase’s health issues and to  come up with a possible treatment plan,  to manage these long term conditions.
The bailiseston and Sandyhills branches are both amazing. They do go above and beyond to help in the best way that they possibly can.
I don’t think any of my dogs would have survived without their help. Both dogs are thriving and loving life thanks to these wonderful human beings.
Absolutely brilliant vets easy to find. Everyone was so welcoming and friendly & I loved they had Dog too

My boy was in today for an operation and the staff took amazing care of him.  They kept me updated and provided alot of guidance to ensure his aftercare was done to the highest standard.  Staff are all so amazing and so welcoming.  I have all 4 of my pets at Baillieston and I would highly recommend the vet to anyone looking.

Loki, Milo, Beau and Gilbert highly approve also 😊
We had a great experience with the litter of pups hanging there vet check and immunisations before going to there new homes the staff in Baillieston as so welcoming
Very friendly staff all round x
Great vet. Really good with my 12 week old cocker spaniel. Made his vaccinations easy.

Was seen that day without having an appointment. Vet was very thorough and put our minds at ease. We left feeling very comfortable, having given us many options. Fourth year of using ScotVet and find them very capable and most helpful, polite and professional. Every vet/nurse at the practice, which my dog has seen, has always been exceptional.
All the staff at Scotvet Baillieston provide excellent service.

The staff were very helpful as they were due to close at 12pm on Saturday and I phoned them about 11.30am .they asked me to bring my dog down who had been vomiting blood. He was seen by the vet and givin some treatment that helped him and we felt reassured when we left as they gave him a good check over. Thank you Scotvet.

They look after my array of animals like they are family.
More recently my 11 year old Shih Tzu had to have a lot of dental work but it was all done and she was treated so well.
Thank you
Always helpful.
Jess quickly and thoroughly assessed wee Mylo and gave appropriate treatment that had him on his feet in no time. Everyone friendly and helpful as always.

I took teddy my Maltese for booster plus get his ears checked the vet was so good with teddy as he's s drama queen teddy doesn't like anyone cleaning his ears they managed but teddy was traumatized before the touched him so it's good to know they can deal with my dog yelping for nothing lol
Brilliant vet,very helpful and polite,always there when we need them👍 …
Outstanding vet’s and staff. Clean and tidy environment and always helpful
Cannot fault the team at Baillieston, my dog recieved 1st class care during and after being spayed, the wee nurse that looked after Lily was lovely and very informative
Fantastic service, turned up first thing on a Saturday morining without an appointment with a very sick dog and was seen straight away…
Beaka goes above and beyond for my Bella,  as all the team do. Excellent 👌

Have recently visited the ScotVet Baillieston branch and have visited both practices with my dogs. The staff are all fantastic from reception right through to the nurses and vets. I had to take my boy Bailey to be put to sleep as he was in a lot of pain and increased pain meds were not helping.  The staff were all amazing. The care, kindness and compassion shown to both myself and Bailey was very much appreciated. They sent Bailey on his last journey over the rainbow bridge with dignity and respect. We were not rushed and everything was very well explained throughout the process. They very kindly gave me paw prints and fur clippings and a lovely card with a thoughtful heartfelt message inside.
I can not rate the ScotVet team any higher or I would. I recommend them to everyone as they really are the best!
I am happy to continue as part of the ScotVet family with my other dog Brodie. 🐾🐾
I had Brodie the cocker spaniel in for his yearly vaccination and he was treated with great care and affection.
The staff i seen today while in with my puppy for her last part of her vaccination was so helpful and caring. She was absolutely amazing so sorry I cant remember her name!! Thank you so so much
Just feel so expensive!!!

Lovely group of people that work here & they don't try and charge you for things you don't need. When I told them I was on a budget the vet advised me where to get things cheaper. Would highly recommend this vet.
Very happy with the service provided Very professional and welcoming when we have visited
Excellent service as always

I’ve recently just joined Scotvet and can honestly say  staff are absolutely lovely. Bieke has been looking after my Pomeranian with  nothing but the best care . So glad I came her feel my dog is in the best hands so reassuring. Highly recommend scotvet. 🐾🐾I now have a new puppy who is also in the care of beike I just love the care and attention that Vito has been given . The staff are so helpful and friendly they are great with Vito . Always feel reassured that Vito gets the very best care coming here. 🐾🐾
All staff are kind,caring and understanding. X
I have used this vet for many years the staff are brilliant and the vets have been great with my animals
This is my first time giving Scot vet a go. The girls at reception and Craig the vet   were marvellous and I’m glad I’ve went with them.

The vets has lots of lovely people, who work very hard to help animals. My little one had to get surgery to remove a lump, they did great work while making sure to console and update me throughout. The patient has 2 more appointment but is doing great!
Consistently kind and relaxed with my fearful dog 😃 fantastic attitude and understanding
Great experience. All the staff are welcoming, friendly and give great advice. Thanks 🐶 …

Thank you for looking after Rose for her 14 years. She passed yesterday and We were so glad that the amazing Craig Smith helped us make Rose comfy with her family around her. She was an amazing dog. We were so lucky to have her.
Thank you Scotvet staff.
Eileen Fern
Love this vet practice. From reception to vet, their all lovely 😍

I cannot fault Scotvet for the exemplary treatment our fur baby Charley received this week, Craig and his assistant listened to our concerns with Charley, as she is a mature lady now, they were very thorough in examining her and gave us excellent advice, we honestly thought we wouldn’t be taking her home, I cannot thank them enough 🐶🐾🐶🐾🐶🐾🥰
Always fantastic service
Great vet and service, always friendly staff !

My first visit very professional full health check from head to Tip of her tail. Little skin irritation. I get nails clipped, flee, ticks and worming.that goes with my pet plan. My cat was taking care of in the nice softest approach.I didn’t walk out a Huge vet bill £7. For a solution to wash her with my anxiety is taken away. Realising that not every Vet appointment is going to cost a fortune.I’d recommend the vet practice to everyone be happy to tell them. Thank you

I’ve been taking my dogs to this practice for years and, generally, I’ve always found the vets themselves to be very good.

I recently took my dog in with a skin issue and was charged £55 for the initial consultation, plus medication, which I was perfectly happy with. I was then asked to arrange a follow-up appointment, which I did. However, when I attended the follow-up, I was charged another £50 consultation fee, on top of the cost of further medication.

I appreciate that veterinary practices are businesses and there are costs involved, but I do feel the consultation fees are quite steep, particularly when the follow-up appointment was only around 10 minutes and was directly related to the original issue.

I’m not complaining about the care my dog received — the vets have always been good — but I do think the pricing for follow-up consultations could be reviewed. I go to the dentist and don’t normally pay another full consultation fee for a follow-up, so it did come as a bit of a surprise.

I’ve been loyal to this practice for years, but unfortunately the costs may make me consider trying another vet in the future.

Always caring and professional have been great with our wee dog Barney. Most recent visit was an emergency one where Barney may have been stung in the mouth by a wasp and was hyperventilating and acting really erratically and, with their help and treatment,  he was back to normal by next day
The staff are caring and friendly.  Wouldn’t go anywhere else.

We visited Sandyhills with Spike to get bloods and weight, he was getting himself excited cos he was going out in the car he was panting heavily and by the time we reached the house at Garrowhill he got himself into a state and he was struggling to breathe. We went straight up to Baillieston and asked for him to be seen right away.
Craig came out and got him and immediately took him thru to get oxygen. He was sedated too and as he started overheating put in a cold shower. His temperature went up to 41.
If he wasn’t seen there and then Spike wouldn’t be here today! Craig and team stayed late with him as he wouldn’t have made it to an overnight facility. They saved his life! Thanks to u guys Spikes recovering at home today … thank you xx

I am registered with the vet for over 5 years now however I noticed one off the vets is not very tolerant towards breeders. I felt very awkward on one occasion when I brought in my cats and felt misjudged. I am breeding for over 8 years never had any issues and I even got asked if I’ve got a licence for breeding the cats which I have. . I am disappointed with the vet as I never had any problems with them in a past. I am now leaving the vet and looking toward my new vet

Came at short notice when our little whippet hurt her leg.  Staff were great as always, taking time to put Tiffy at ease and giving her a very thorough examination.  Thankfully nothing serious, and she's on the mend.

Very pleasant and efficient service.  Took great care with our wee dog.

Very friendly staff, and clean environment

As always the staff were great when we had Tiffy's nails clipped. Very gentle with our very timid whippet

Zeus is always so well looked after every time he comes here! Never had an issue since he was 8 weeks old because of the care the staff put into making him comfortable - I’ve never seen a dog excited to go to the vets before!
Ty for making my boy so comfortable when in for his Jags and check up. As always great service 💖

1st time using this vet , staff are very nice . Vet did a very good examination of my dog , did some blood tests etc and called next day as promised , still waiting on other results . i was seen at short notice i,d highly recommend . Belle was very comfortable being examined & having various tests done .
Took great care and attention to my wee fog, very professional
ScotVet Baillieston are absolutely amazing the care that both my chihuahuas Millie and Mia has received from all staff has been phenomenal. Cannot recommend them enough
I have always had a quick service using the app ,staff are always  helpful and pleasant. Staff have been great with my dog alot time and patience never had any issues.

My first phone call to Scot vet was heartbreaking for me regarding my cat who was 18 years old I knew it was time to say farewell the girl on reception was great the vet who treated max was very professional and understanding thanks again from Max & Me

Couldn't ask for anything more from a vets than what both the ballieston and sandyhills practices provide. We have now had three dogs registered with them, Jack and Archie who have both passed and now wee Harry. The care they provide is second to none. I'm never made to feel like concerns are silly and their advice is spot on. Can't recommend enough.

Bella visited the vet to have a haircut as some of her fur had become matted and she would not let anyone groom her.
Very pleased with the result and Bella looking happy too.
She back to normal next day, all good
Thanks
James
Fantastic service from lovely staff fitted me in due to a cancellation would highly recommend

Staff are really friendly and helpful, took time to answer any questions i had about my kitten and his first jags, i felt very confident my kitten was recieving the best care and treatment possible. Its a lovely vet to attend.

Thankyou for the help of our oversea Puppy.
Verry friendly Staff ⚕️ and Vet.  Thankyou

Staff are always friendly especially reception as you first walk in. Always feel welcome. Appointment was conducted in time and I wasn’t left waiting.  Eat was informative and offered good advice. Handled my dog Rapha very well.
Moved to Scotvet 2 years ago so glad I did vets are amazing with my boy. My boy slightly nervous but loads of vet cuddles. Reception staff are very helpful. Would recommend.

All staff are amazing,  nurses, receptionists and couldn't ask for better vets than Louise,  Craig and Bieke. They have cared for my pets for over 20 years  and never been less than amazing. Thank you  to all sraff
As always brilliant service from Scotvet Ballieston , Pearl loves all the attention she gets , also find it less expensive than our old vet !
Great vet!

The staff are always lovely, the owners of the practice are always greedy. Having had dogs for nearly 30 years I find the prices in this practice have increased far beyond making a profit. Charged £102 for medication I can get online for £10.80 plus the vets prescription price, that’s lone shark profit margins!
Excellent friendly and professional care.

Brilliant care to my cats and dogs.
So we have found a vet that is not constantly trying to sell us products.
The staff are excellent
Highly recommend. I bring my two cats here and the team is always incredibly supportive, helpful, and informative.Ollie and Zara get the best care here.
Callum kindly gave up his lunch yesterday to see our frenchie as he was in a lot of pain, best vets around .
Ever so helpful

The staff at ScotVet are fantastic! I have been bringing my family dogs here for years. Their service, care and compassion is outstanding.
Excellent service first time at this vet with my new puppy friendly service at reception clean environment vet very friendly and lots of information gained  highly recommend
The best vet in the eastend all ways go above and beyond to help you
Since joining Scotvet I have no complaints, anytime I have a query I call and the lovely staff put me at ease, I haven't waited long for appointments and the place is always clean
The vet was so professional and caring I couldn’t be happier with the care Leo got, and also the reception staff as well. Thank you
We moved both our dogs here during Covid after being with our last vet for nearly 40yrs and it was the best decision we made sometimes change is good and that’s exactly what happened for us 🥰 …

Can't thank the team enough here, they are always so kind and have such patience with my pet, I may not always be at the vet with Kylie but when I need them they are always happy to help her and also calm me in the process. Thank you to all the team for all you do 😊 …
Phenomenal pet service!

We have been using ScotVet for over 20 years for both our past and present dogs, and we couldn't be happier with the care they provide. The entire team is incredibly friendly, professional, and always goes above and beyond to make sure our pets are well looked after. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a fantastic vet! 5 stars!

Bobby attended Baillieston practice for a weigh-in and regular check-up as part of his medication review.
All staff very friendly and attentive to Bobby and ourselves.
Thanks for great service.
Took my dog for his booster shot.. staff very friendly and helpful very nice experience
Have been with Scotvet for years with all my pets. Service has always been amazing, have never had any complaints. You can tell they genuinely love and care for animals. 100% recommend
Very friendly group great service
Excellent service. My Westie Theo was put at ease to get his booster.

Found all the staff I had dealings with very professional and they were very helpful when I was asking questions the only negative was I had to pay for my pets treatment but that was my fault thought I was at ScotFree not ScotVet lol.
Excellent service

Unfortunately the wee man has cancer. Doesn't have long left. We'd pay our last penny to keep him here.
Scotvet. Please do not take your dog here. We collected him after his diagnosis. A vet wasn't even there to tell us anything.  A veterinary assistant. Seriously. The least you could do is have a vet speak to us . We've just paid about £1000.00 pounds for a scan , blood test and antibiotics within a week. And a vet nope. No money no call. Obviously I'm angry and emotional. But FFS.  This is disgusting.
This is not professional. It's vile tbh.
Brilliant vet practice.Concerned about their patients,Take time to examine the pets and explain the way forward to help them.Can't thank them enough.
Always professional and kind recommend to everyone with pets.
Just switched from our previous vets and so glad we did. Such a calmer nicer experience for our cat and us, was great having cats & dogs seperated and even having calming blankets for your cat.
Great service and care.

I have bring my wee dog Mylo to Scotvet for a number of years now. He injured his leg and got an appointment the same day.
The vet I seen was great and explained what he had injured. also the receptionist were great and very helpful. Would recommend them to any pet lovers 😁 …
Wonderful vet surgery. Staff all so friendly. Saw Maisie right on her appointment time. Surgery is clean and tidy.
Scotvet has a homely feel to it, I have a shihtzu and he can be quite nippy, but here he was quite relaxed,the staff are so friendly.

I took both Theo and Cozmo for their annual vaccinations and the vet was amazing at keeping them calm and showed them lots of affection, which the two of them adored. Best vet I’ve been to since I got the boys last year. Highly recommend.
Brought my two greyhounds here for over six years. They are amazing and wouldn't go anywhere else.

Staff lovely and friendly
Great service
Totally recommend

Had my 3 dogs into Scotvet over the past week for check ups,  worming & boosters etc Everyone is friendly, welcoming and supportive.  The vets actually listen to what you say and help make the best choices for your pet.
They have seen our family go through lots of heartache with our pets in recent years, always at the end of a phone for guidance. 5*
Thank yous all very much for all your help with Harry I was made to feel very comfortable and the the staff were so friendly thanks very much

Never had a bad experience at either of ScotVet’s locations. They’re always great with my cat - even though he’s super spicy this has never been a problem for them. He’s been in for 2 dental operations in the past year and both times they’ve seen him really quickly and identified that he needed the operations (same day of me phoning up with the issues). They give a price estimate prior to the surgery and clearly explain everything that’s happening. They’re also reasonably priced, without skimping on care.
Ziva is anxious at the vet so very vocal but the staff are all great with her. They are all very friendly and caring so I know that my dogs are in the best hands.
Friendly, caring vets who always do everything possible to keep pets healthy. Routine vaccines for my dog this time and the vet was patient and kind.

I've been taking my 2 dogs here since I got them and all the staff have been nothing but welcoming, helpful & kind. My dogs always get the best care, very well looked after. Highly recommend to anyone looking for the perfect vet for their pets! Thank you ScotVet Baillieston!

Friendly and professional service all staff made  Simba (our puppy) from age 12wks and me feel so welcome.  Simba isn't  nervous at all he loves the attention all staff are so friendly and Scotvet (Baillieston) provides s safe space for pets and owners to use.   I highly recommend Scot Vets Baillieston
Jinky received his usual high standard of care. Thanks again.
Excellent service from start to finish
Very loving with my wee Archie got all the things done that he needed will be back

My boy chester had his first operation at scotvet. (Neutured) . I was really happy with the reassurance from start to finish and the staff catered to myself and when was best for me to fit the operation in.
The information beforehand was great .

On collection my boy came out so happy to see me and it really made me feel relaxed knowing he was very well cared for whilst in their hands.

Thank you so much

Our 18 year old cat Charlie became suddenly unwell with an abscess on his cheek which subsequently burst and  we were so worried about him. The care he received from the first visit to the vet was just amazing and the thoughtful way we were treated with everything being explained to us in detail. He ended up having an operation and he is now recovering really well. We cannot thank everyone at Scotvet who helped him and us enough. From the receptionists , Vets, anaesthetist and the veterinary nurse the care he received was amazing. We are so grateful and we really recommend all pet owners to consider taking their furbabies to Scotvet.
Amazing vets so kind friendly and caring very recommended
First time taking our Vinnie to the vet, the receptionist’s were amazing as was our Vet Callum. Very easy and stress free, thankyou all :)
All the staff are absolutely lovely. Very welcoming. The Vet my puppy say Yun I think her name was . Was great . Deno was calm with her The  whole time .
Got same day appointment, vet was really good with anxious dog and spent time answering my questions! Highly recommend 👌 …

Yesterday I took both my young male cats (18 months) to Scotvet in baillieston and was so pleased. My cats get very anxious on car rides and at the vet but the separated cat area made things so much easier for them. As well as the option of the covers sprayed with feliway spray that you can use to cover there boxes to help calm them down that are avaliable in the cat waiting area was great option as it helped calm them down massively. The vet we saw was amazing and so gently with them and caring. The boys don’t normally deal with vets very well and get very scared but they actually handled it so well as and the vet took his time and the care shown was amazing and both boys became so relaxed with the vet and allowed him to do his checks with no fuss and even came round to vet so easily for some claps. The reception team were so lovely as well and helpful also. So glad I choose Scotvet would highly recommend them so far.
Very professional, warm greeting from staff, dog treated very well, came very highly recommended and didn't disappoint, I would definitely recommend using this vets.
A lot of money for the  amount of time I was in the consultation

Great vets and nurses all the staff are lovely. They go above and beyond to look after your pets. Couldn’t ask for anything more in the treatment they give my 2 dogs. Also staff are very friendly and nothing is a bother to them. Mylo and Minni always get a treat wen their leaving. 🐶💚🐶💞 …
Great caring vets
the vet that looked at my cat was very good and helpful and friendly
An excellent service. Great advice and professional support. Staff are always very friendly and welcoming. I constantly recommend to others.

When Winnie had a seizure recently, the vets at Scotvet were able to arrange an appointment tge same day. Callum handled her with care and was thorough and gentle in examining her. He was empathetic to me and gave options for moving forward, showing sensitivity to the fact that money can be an issue when processing. When asked directly, he advised what he would do in my position.
Blood tests were done and processed within hours and Callum phoned me later to let me know the results and to offer further advice. An excellent service; efficient, empathetic and professional from all members of the team.

Callum , Louise & Craig were fantastic with my dog Buster. They are very easy to communicate with me as I’m deaf.they are very helpful & friendly. ScotVet is the best in Scotland.
Karen Banks
Took my older dog to the vets and they have been brilliant with her she was being sick and they couldn't do enough to help her would highly recommend
I would like to thank all the staff the vets  nurses and receptionists for looking after daisy when she was unwell.everyone was so kind and caring and im glad to say daisy is on the mend
Very good, friendly and caring service.
All staff were really attentive. Welcoming and very helpful 🤗 …

After a disappointing experience at our previous surgery we registered Buddy at Scotvet, from the moment we registered the difference in care was clear , the team welcomed us and took the time to understand Buddy’s history, Buddy has received outstanding care here over the last few days when he had been really sick , I would definitely recommend them , thank you for restoring our trust and taking care of our fur baby ,

Finn our puppy Golden Doodle is now 9 months old he attends the Team  at Scotvet for his monthly weigh in and tick and worming treatment. The team are so kind with him particularly as he has no size awareness as approaches the reception team in an explosion of excitement- he is so confident with the team with no apprehension about attending which is so reassuring especially as he grows weighing in most recently at a whopping 28.2kg. Thank you to all the team for ongoing care and kindness.

We had our dog Baillie in and her 7 puppies for there mircrochipping & first immunisations
The team were great and everything went smoothly
Can’t recommend them enough

I was down with one off my dogs 4 week ago and they took blood from him but they came back not reit so they left me for 2 weeks then I had to say he has but weight on now he has floud In his belly and pews but his pew was so so swollen but now I got tablets for him and what a difference in one night in his pews so lets hope and pray they work and all his flood out his body as I know he is old but there is things they can try not saying it works all the time but if they do want the best for your pet and if you love your animals you would pay and do anything for them this was his pew last night and now it has when down
First time visiting this vets with our puppy and couldn’t be more happy. All staff are super friendly and helpful.
Great service as always got a check over and his Kennel cough jag the vet was very good with Toby and he was weighed too

10 out of 10 given to the staff at ScotVet,
especially Craig, who always puts my little dog at ease when she has an appointment. Like most of our furry babies she becomes very nervous on arrival. Craig is very caring, compassionate, and obviously cares about the well-being of the animals he is treating. Knowing that your little one is in good hands is a relief for me and obviously my little dog. Highly recommend ☺️
Vets are very friendly and helpful here and the receptionists are very friendly 😀 …
Great care given to Bailey . Very friendly staff . Great service by all . Thank you 🐾🐾 …
We have had our dog in three times now - twice for vaccinations and once for neutering. The care has been fantastic and the staff are really friendly.

My elderly dog Skye had an op for bladder stones.  I can't thank them enough for their care and ability to look after my old girl as she is a very nervous dog and doesn't take to people well.  Thanks to their quick treatment she is well on the mend.

Can't thank the staff at Scotvet Baillieston enough for all their help. My wee Lhasa Apso Teddy has had numerous health issues of late and the staff are brilliant with him. (He can be a stubborn wee devil at times lol!).They are always so helpful and accommodating. Thanks so much guys. 👍☺️ …
Always the best, happy dog happy owner 🎈 …
Always very friendly staff. Vets are amazing and very helpful.
Vet and staff lovely. Highly recommend. Don’t feel pressured to take treatment etc.  and consult is not rushed. Very happy with all care provided for my dogs.
As a first time pet owner I strongly recommend this vet due to the friendly staff and straight forward in and out procedure taking steps to make sure your animal is as comfortable as possible!
Was able to get my dog seen very last minute after he had been injured.  Staff are very friendly and explained everything going on.  Would highly recommend

Fantastic, very friendly service. My guinea pig Theodore was unwell and I had emailed to try to register and they got back to me immediately with an appointment and he was taken in for treatment a few days later. He is recovering well now 😁 i would definitely recommend Scotvet's services. Thankyou …

We have 3 huskies and have had a litter of 5 pups the vets and staff at both the baillieston and Sandyhills clinics are second to none they are kind caring and considerate towards us as owners and are absolutely fantastic With our pets. Scottish_Huskies (TikTok & Instagram) highly recommend Scot vets
Staff are brilliant and I am really pleased with the vet club idea.  We have had the new pup checked every month and his flea/worm treatment been provided.

I was initially with another vet practice who I felt were not taking my concerns seriously I phoned scotvet to register with them was seen the next day was told to bring my kitten back in 2 days for xrays the practices kept me informed throughout the day and also phoned later that night to ensure my baby was OK and spoke me through the next steps that need to be taken to fix the issue

I would definitely recommend this practice reception staff were friendly and helpful vets were friendly informative and helpful
Staff friendly and helpful vet absolutely brilliant shadow made to feel at ease

Couldn’t recommend Scotvet enough after multiple appointments for my cat (unfortunately!).
